indicator_profile: TRADINGONE_V2 public source math; ML RSI not used
watch: H1 AO first slope deceleration or directional slope reversal; independent side memories
confirm: Within watch lifetime: AO and pececillos slopes aligned, closed 15m break or later retest of known fractal; ADX/BBWP/context descriptive only
invalidate: Opposite H1 AO slope reversal or opposite 15m structural break; expiry after 2 hours
recovery: Record indicator/price displacement separately from known watch anchor; no optimized displacement threshold
fred: UNVERIFIED; record sign, slope, acceleration and red-line relation only; do not emit a Fred signal
tsa: TRADINGONE_V2 TSA119/2.8/50/100; not Hermi117/2.8/150/100 nor certified Bitman line

simulation.stop: Further of 1.5 H1 ATR from next-open fill and known 15m fractal plus .2 H1 ATR buffer
simulation.entry: First following 15m open with adverse slippage; reject gaps/noncontiguous data
simulation.ambiguous: Stop first when both touched inside same 15m; excursions are full-bar bounds
simulation.be: Use audited cost-aware runner formula; activate BE/trail only for following 15m bar
simulation.funding: Spot NOT_APPLICABLE, synthetic SHORT is not borrow/executable futures; futures results blocked without settlement data
simulation.averaging: Never add in broker; pure exposure assessment includes realized loss and all lots, same campaign
simulation.halt: No new trades after 5% marked-equity drawdown; halt latched for replay, never resets on reentry
simulation.end_of_data: Keep open position marked and CENSORED; never invent a closing fill

scope: Engineering reconstruction of selected/previously observed cases; not performance validation or forward capture
